Chapter 1101: 25: Fierce Sun Splits The Sky (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1101: Chapter 25: Fierce Sun Splits the Sky (Seeking Subscription)_2

And now?

Lin Yuan’s actual combat strength is only close to the peak of a Great Lord.

“With the might of this Physical Body Divine Ability, once I step into the Chaos Realm, there will be basically no Great Lord or Heavenly Venerate who can be my opponent.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If he were in the Chaos Void, even someone as strong as a Great Saint would be swept away by Lin Yuan.

The Great Lord of this source world is equivalent to a Venerate in the Chaos Void, while a Heavenly Venerate is equivalent to a Great Saint.

However, this Divine Skill is not without its shortcomings, it consumes too much. Lin Yuan finds it difficult to control it perfectly. In a one-on-one or one-on-many situation, Lin Yuan naturally has nothing to fear, but if they attack one after another?

Striking during the interval when Lin Yuan activates this Divine Skill, Lin Yuan feels a bit of a headache.

“No matter what, this Divine Skill is definitely the strongest trump card I currently possess. Even the skill known for its pure killing power, ‘Tear Heaven,’ is no match.”

Lin Yuan was radiant with confidence.

The Divine Skill ‘Tear Heaven’ only has that one ‘tear,’ while ‘Sunshine Opening’ can last for a period of time, equivalent to a greatly enhanced version of the Divine Ability ‘World.’

Of course, the mysteries involved in the Divine Skill ‘Sunshine Opening’ far surpass those of the skill ‘World.’

So far, Lin Yuan’s thoughts have been focused on the might of ‘Sunshine Opening,’ but in fact, this skill leans more toward ‘creation’ and ‘formation.’

As for destruction? That’s just one aspect of it.

…

[Name: Yu Yan (Lin Yuan)]

[Identity: Master of the Myriad Realms Gate]

[Bonded Talent: Heaven-defying Comprehension]

[Divine Power: Blood Resurrection]

[Divine Power: Mountain Moving]

[Divine Power: Strengthening]

[Divine Power: Elemental Body]

[Divine Power: World]

[Divine Power: Tear Heaven]

[Divine Power: Sunshine Opening]

[Current State: Consciousness Arrival]

[Remaining Stay Time: None]

…

Lin Yuan glanced at the timely ‘update’ of the seventh Divine Skill in the lower left corner of his vision.

“The urgent task now is to comprehend this Divine Skill imprint.”

Lin Yuan calmed his mind. Only by understanding this Divine Skill imprint can he bring it back to the Chaos Void for use among the various true body Primordial Spirit Avatars.

Of course, the comprehension here does not refer to understanding the essence of ‘Sunshine Opening’; that is too difficult for Lin Yuan to achieve.

It simply means understanding the imprint of this Divine Skill.

It’s like a high-tech product, where you only need to perfectly replicate each component to be able to reassemble it.

As for the function and effect of each component, it can be studied slowly later.

“Before understanding it, I must not die.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself silently.

The current physical body is the carrier of the Divine Skill ‘Sunshine Opening.’ If he dies, the Divine Skill imprint will dissipate, and before comprehending it, it means he has completely lost this skill.

This is a price Lin Yuan cannot accept.

As for choosing to travel again… there are no two identical lives. If he chooses to travel again, Lin Yuan is not sure if he can continue to awaken the Divine Skill ‘Sunshine Opening.’

Moreover, choosing to travel again means Lin Yuan has to start all over again.

The time and effort previously spent would be wasted.

“But with my current strength, as long as I am cautious, it should be very difficult to die.”

Lin Yuan thought confidently to himself. For over a thousand years, most of his true body has been in seclusion for cultivation, but the two major Primordial Spirit Avatars have essentially roamed through various large domains nearby, setting up life-saving measures.

Unless the Ancestors of the various Ancient Countries, those thirteenth-tier time beings make a personal move, wanting to completely kill Lin Yuan is almost impossible.

…

Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Red Pine Domain.

This large domain is the fiefdom of the royal Spirit Might King,

and the Spirit Might King is the enfeoffed king responsible for resisting Red Pine King’s Spirit Might King on this side of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Similar to the Spirit Might King, the Red Pine King’s enfeoffed kingship comes from his royal identity, with strength equivalent to the peak of a Great Lord.

However, unlike the Spirit Might King, the Red Pine King is not very ambitious and has no intention of becoming the emperor of an Ancient Country.

In the royal city, an avatar of Lord Qingfen is standing before a man with a lazy expression.

“Your Highness, I worry that the Spirit Might King might seek help from his brother.”

Lord Qingfen voiced his concerns.

The Spirit Might King’s brother is a Great Lord with a bloodline concentration meeting the core royal requirements.

Once such an entity joins the battlefield, who could withstand it on the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s side?

The core royalty at the level of a Great Lord can, with its powerful ancestral bloodline, practically sweep through others of the same level, and at the peak of Great Lord, even wrestle with a Heavenly Venerate.

And unlike a normal Heavenly Venerate, the core royalty is ultimately at the level of a Great Lord, so even if they take action, it won’t dramatically escalate the war’s intensity.

“That Spirit Might King, to become emperor, might indeed do such a thing.”

Red Pine King said, his expression lazy but his tone grew slightly solemn.

If Lord Qingfen’s post is breached, the enfeoffed king responsible for commanding the war would certainly bear responsibility as well.

“Leave this matter to me.”

Red Pine King said as he looked at Lord Qingfen.

“Yes.”

Lord Qingfen breathed a slight sigh of relief.

With Red Pine King’s intervention, there is a high probability that they can invite a Great Lord level core royal to counter the Spirit Might King’s brother.

“Let me think.”

With a thought, Red Pine King instantly gathered an avatar in the distant capital.

As a royal of an Ancient Country, usually needing to stay stationed in the fiefdom, he can also return to the capital at any time.

Red Pine King soon arrived at a sprawling mansion.

“Sixth Brother.”

Red Pine King waited outside.

His Sixth Brother is a core royal who usually busies himself with comprehending the ancestral bloodline and rarely involves himself in other matters.
